title: Learning to Summarize from Human Feedback
authors: N. Stiennon, L. Ouyang, J. Wu, D. Ziegler, R. Lowe, C. Voss, A. Radford, D. Amodei, et al. (9 authors)
before: Summarisation models were trained to imitate reference summaries and scored with ROUGE.
problem: Reference summaries are not what people actually prefer, and ROUGE does not measure quality.
breakthrough: Train a reward model on human comparisons of summaries and optimise against it, beating human reference summaries.
why: The proof that RLHF works on a real language task, and the direct template for InstructGPT.
next: InstructGPT generalised the recipe from summarisation to instruction following.
inherits: The full three-stage RLHF pipeline as practised today.
